name: Leo SEVIN
intro: I am a PE teacher with 8 years of experience, including PE coordination and Cambridge IGCSE PE. I currently teach at Crescendo-HELP International School in Malaysia.
bridge: I build my own digital tools to make progress visible to students and teachers in one place. Here is what I would bring:
bulletsWhenNoHook: Here is what I would bring:

bullets.text: PE assessment. I co-wrote expectations for each sport and year group on four levels. In my self-assessment app, students rate themselves at the first and last lesson of each unit and I assess them at the first, middle and last. They earn house points for their performance and for the accuracy of their self-assessment, so progress is measured and rewarded.

Programme and events. At Saigon Star I led PE programming and assessment across the UK, IPC and IMYC curricula and introduced a House Team system. I now organise events in the JSAC and FOBISIA circuits.

IGCSE tools. My online IGCSE PE workbook covers all 11 chapters of the Collins Cambridge IGCSE PE book: 187 questions checked against it, auto-marked quizzes and a leaderboard. My gym training app lets students calculate their repetition maximum (RM) easily and accurately, then start a muscular training plan with a clear intention linked to their sport.

availability: My contract ends in July 2027, so I can start in August 2027.
websiteLine: You can see my teaching style, videos and apps on {website}
closing: Thank you for your time. I would welcome a short call to discuss how I could contribute to your PE department.
